name: The Verdict of Helene
source:
One day, Tomoharu Saegusa, a young man drifting through life, is approached by a mysterious woman in a station bookstore. Accepting her invitation, he embarks on a journey toward an unknown destiny. Little does he know that this meeting will change his life forever, leading him toward the "Verdict."

[From [url=https://nwaraee1certarwrf.itch.io/theverdictofhelene]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，在生活中漂泊的年轻人三枝智春在车站书店里遇到了一名神秘女子。他接受了她的邀请，踏上了通往未知命运的旅程。他不知道这次会面将永远改变他的生活，引导他走向“判决”。

[来自[url=https://nwaraee1certarwrf.itch.io/theverdictofhelene]itch.io[/url]]
